purpose: Express an extreme feeling or quality conversationally.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Adjective / N + といったらない
The view from the summit is indescribably beautiful.
The anxiety while waiting for the reply was unbearable.
Carrying it all alone is incredibly hard.
formation: Adjective / N + といったらない
restrictions: Often used with feelings, tiredness, or degree evaluations.
mistake: It is an idiomatic exclamation, not an actual conditional statement.
